text:
lena: Quick pulse — who’s in for a cookie exchange + ugly mug contest next Friday in the office? :cookie: :mug: 

mike: Count me in! I’ll bring a batch of gluten-free snickerdoodles.

anya: I’ll bring vegan ginger snaps :raised_hands: also down for the mug contest (penguin mug ready).

jamie: I will be the official mug judge (trained professional).

hr-bot: Reminder: Holiday potluck RSVP closes Wed at 5pm. Please fill the form in #help if you haven't.

sam: Love this. Can we also do a tiny prize for ‘most charmingly ugly’ mug? :trophy: :santa:

ria: Are Secret Santa signups happening or just open exchange?

lena: No Secret Santa this year — keep it simple: cookie exchange + mug shenanigans.

noah: For remote folks — can we do a virtual mug parade? Zoom + camera-on show-and-tell?

lena: Yes — remote pals welcome. We’ll set a Zoom link and a separate time slot for the parade.

olivia: Quick poll: react with :thumbsup: for morning (10–11am) or :thumbsdown: for afternoon (3–4pm).

annie: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsdown:

olivia: Tally so far — morning 2, afternoon 1. Keep reacting!

jamie: PSA: please label allergens on anything you bring (peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy).

lena: Thanks — will add an allergen column to the sign-up sheet. Also small prize for Ugliest Mug — assemble your worst ceramics.

hr-bot: Company holiday closure reminder: Office closed 12/24–1/1. If you need an exception, contact People Ops.

sam: Best news of the day :tada:

lena: Appreciate it all — i'll drop the organizer doc + signup link in this thread tomorrow and ping folks who said they'd bring treats. Any volunteers to be mug-photographer? :camera_with_flash:

anya: I can take photos. I will also enforce good mug-placement angles.

ria: If anyone wants to leave cookies in the kitchen earlier, please put them on the labeled tray so remote folks can still see via camera.

noah: Can we add a mini category: Most Thematically Confused Mug? I have one that is half-snowman, half-pumpkin.

jamie: That sounds delightfully wrong. I’m in.

lena: Amazing. Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up with link + schedule. For now: cookies, mugs, cameras, and labels. :heart:

olivia: Also — meme submissions welcome. I already have one titled ‘When you realize the cookies are all gone’.

sam: post it pls :joy:
